English.Char_Desc_80: Free tool that fixes PDF line breaks, drops formatting and pastes tables cleanly
English.Char_Desc_250: PasteFit cleans what you copied before you paste it on Windows. Press a shortcut, check the preview and press Enter. It fixes broken lines from PDFs, removes formatting, makes one line and pastes tables cleanly into Word, Outlook or Excel.
English.Char_Desc_450: PasteFit is a free, portable Windows tool that cleans what you copied before you paste it. Press Win+Alt+V where you want to paste, check the preview and press Enter. It joins lines that a PDF cut in the middle of a sentence, removes fonts and colors, puts text on one line for a field or cell, and pastes tables as real tables in Word and Outlook or as cells in Excel. It reads the clipboard only when you press the shortcut and keeps no history.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
PasteFit is a free Windows tool that cleans up what you copied before you paste it. Press a shortcut where you want to paste, look at the preview, and press Enter. The recommended way is already selected, and the window shows exactly what it changed.
It joins lines that were cut in the middle of a sentence, as in text copied from a PDF, while keeping paragraphs and list items. It removes fonts, colors and links and cleans up stray spaces. It puts it all on one line for a search box, an input field or a single cell. Tables from web pages or Excel paste as clean tables in Word, Outlook and web browsers, and as cells in Excel. Line joining follows the rules of each language: Chinese and Japanese text is joined without spaces.
PasteFit reads the clipboard only at the moment you press the shortcut. It does not watch the clipboard, keeps no history and sends nothing over the internet. If a password manager marks what you copied, the preview hides it. It does not type into windows that run as administrator; there, press Ctrl+V.
One exe file, no installation (about 9 MB), available in 11 languages. Free, no ads. No administrator rights needed.
